notes.title: The Challenge Update (28-06-2017)
notes.content:
[url=https://gyazo.com/4c25ba4000ef2cac0cd84c237b1812c9][img]https://i.gyazo.com/4c25ba4000ef2cac0cd84c237b1812c9.gif[/img][/url]

Patch notes:
- Introducing Challenge! A new gamemode where you have to finish maps in less than 20 seconds!
- Added the first level for Challenge
- Added screens for finishing Challenge and for failing Challenge
- Fixed two clipping issues in Chapter 1
- Fixed hitboxes for finish box in all Chapters
- Fixed issue where you could finish Chapter 17 by hitting the back of the finish box shelter
- Changed position of the finish box in some maps
- Renamed 'Choose a Chapter' to 'Chapter Selector'
- Artwork on the Store page and in the Steam library updated

notes.title: The Summer Update (23-06-2017)
notes.content:
[url=https://gyazo.com/8b6e80b53f6e7a0069fad7535dcee2f7][img]https://i.gyazo.com/8b6e80b53f6e7a0069fad7535dcee2f7.gif[/img][/url]

Patch notes:
- Made Chapter 13 easier for controller users by adding a new path to finish the Chapter
- Chapter 14 added; A MAZE ING!
- Chapter 15 added; introducing boosters
- Complete makeover of the Chapter Selection menu, you can now switch pages and choose between 14 different Chapters
- Changed the green colour to be more like cyan
- Changed the fog in Chapter 9
- Massive improvements in file size (~2.5gb -> ~1.5gb)

Note that Steam's download servers are quite slow right now, the update might take a while.
